## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and its behavioral impact is described.
- [ ] Automated tests were added or updated, or the reason they are not needed is stated.
- [ ] Manual test results are linked for behavior that mocks or CI cannot prove.
- [ ] Significant feature/integration work adds or updates phase documentation; otherwise
      the Phase field explains why it is not applicable.
- [ ] Requirement IDs link significant behavior to acceptance criteria and tests.
- [ ] New configuration and environment variables are documented.
- [ ] Migration, rollout, and rollback behavior is documented when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private IDs/URLs, customer data, raw private reports, or generated
      datasets are included.
- [ ] Shared logs, screenshots, API responses, and test evidence are sanitized.
- [ ] Backward compatibility is preserved or an explicit migration is documented.
